audit_member_text: L13 indexes dep(1:100,1:72) without checking the dimensions of data returned at L8; a TIFF with fewer than 100 rows or 72 columns causes an out-of-range indexing failure.

The TIFF sample type returned by read(t) at L8 is not normalized before unary negation at L10 and conv2 at L26; conversion to double occurs only at L30, so unsigned or otherwise unsupported TIFF sample classes can saturate, reject negation, or be incompatible with the convolution before the conversion.
The Tiff handle t opened at L7 is read at L8 but never closed through EOF L33, while only the unrelated text fid is closed at L19.

K at L25 uses nine coefficients of 0.11111, whose sum is 0.99999 rather than exactly 1; the interior replacement at L28 therefore slightly attenuates a constant field on every application instead of preserving it exactly.
